title: CAVATAPPI WITH SAUSAGE AND PEAS
content: CAVATAPPI WITH SAUSAGE AND PEAS info About 5 minutes prep, 30 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 small red bell pepper, diced 2 mild italian sausages, casing removed 3 cloves garlic, minced 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper 1 pound cavatappi pasta 1 tablespoon salt 64 oz water 4.5 6 quart pot with lid 1 jar quality pasta sauce (Rao's) 1/2 cup frozen peas 1/4 cup chopped parsley Parmesan cheese and black pepper to taste steps 1. Heat water, salt, and pasta in the pot until boiling. Reduce to simmer and cook 4 minutes. Drain and reserve cooking water. 1. While pasta is cooking, heat dutch oven or large skillet over medium heat ( 2 minutes). Add oil, when it moves easily across pan, add onion. Cook until onion is softened, approximately 5 7 minutes. 1. Add red pepper and cook until softened, approximately 3 5 minutes. Tear sausage into pieces and add to pot. Cook until no longer pink, approximately 5 minutes. Use a cooking spoon to break into crumbles. 1. Once sausage is cooked, add jar of pasta sauce and frozen peas. Cook 2 3 minutes to combine. 1. Off heat, add chopped parsley, cheese, and black pepper. based on https://altonbrown.com/recipes/cold water pasta method/

title: Chicken and Dumplings
content: Chicken and Dumplings A cozy chicken stew with buttery dumplings and plenty of vegetables. info About 1 hour 30 minutes 6 servings ingredients 2 pounds bone in, skin on chicken thighs Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 large yellow onion, diced 4 stalks celery, chopped 6 medium carrots (about 1 1/2 pounds), peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick 4 sprigs thyme 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, plus more as needed 1/4 cup all purpose flour 2 large leeks, white and light green parts thinly sliced 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground pepper 3/4 cup buttermilk 1 large egg 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 1/2 cup parsley, tender leaves and stems, finely chopped (optional) 1/4 cup chives, finely chopped (optional) steps 1. Season the chicken on both sides with salt and pepper. Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat. Working in batches if needed, sear the chicken, skin side down, until deeply golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Flip and continue cooking until browned on the other side, another 5 to 8 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a plate and pour off all the fat into a measuring cup. You should have about 5 tablespoons, depending on the fattiness of the chicken. 1. Leaving the browned bits in the pot, return 2 tablespoons of fat to the pot. Add the onions, celery, and half the carrots. Season with salt and pepper and cook over medium heat, stirring to scrape up the browned bits on the bottom of the pot. Cook until the vegetables start to soften, about 4 minutes. Return the chicken to the pot along with the thyme and 8 cups of water. Simmer, uncovered, until the chicken is completely tender and the liquid has reduced by about 1/4, about 30 to 40 minutes. 1. Transfer the chicken to a plate or cutting board to cool. Strain the stock, which should yield about 5 cups; if you have less, add water to make up the difference. Wipe out the pot. 1. Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons of chicken fat along with 1 tablespoon butter (or enough butter to equal 4 tablespoons of fat if you do not have enough chicken fat) over medium heat. Sprinkle in the flour and stir constantly until pale golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. 1. Slowly whisk in the reserved chicken stock until no lumps remain. It will thicken considerably at first. Bring to a boil. Add the leeks and remaining carrots, season with salt and pepper, and lower the heat to a simmer. 1. Remove and discard the skin and bones from the chicken. Shred the meat and add it to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is nicely thickened and the carrots and leeks are tender, 10 to 12 minutes. 1. Make the dumplings: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper. In a small bowl, whisk together the buttermilk and egg and add to the dry ingredients, followed by the melted butter. Stir just to combine; do not overmix. 1. Using a spoon, drop generous quarter size dollops of the dumpling dough into the pot so they sit on top, spacing them apart as much as possible. Cover the pot and reduce the heat to low. Cook, undisturbed, until the dumplings are puffed and cooked through, 18 to 22 minutes. If needed, test one by cutting it in half; it should be slightly biscuity with no raw dough. 1. Remove the lid and divide the stew among bowls. Sprinkle with parsley and chives, if using. notes The stew is especially good made a day ahead; the flavors deepen overnight. Keep the dumpling dough lightly mixed so the dumplings stay tender. based on Source not recorded

title: Chicken Shawarma
content: Chicken Shawarma A bright, spiced roast chicken with onions and plenty of serving possibilities. info About 1 hour 15 minutes 4 to 6 servings ingredients 2 lemons, juiced 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon olive oil 6 cloves garlic, peeled, smashed, and minced 1 teaspoon kosher salt 2 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper 2 teaspoons ground cumin 2 teaspoons paprika 1/2 teaspoon turmeric A pinch ground cinnamon Crushed red pepper, to taste 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs 1 large red onion, peeled and quartered 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley steps 1. Combine the lemon juice, 1/2 cup olive oil, garlic, salt, pepper, cumin, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, and crushed red pepper in a large bowl and whisk to combine. Add the chicken and toss well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 12 hours. 1. Heat the oven to 425°F. Use the remaining tablespoon of olive oil to grease a rimmed sheet pan. Add the quartered onion to the chicken and marinade, and toss once to combine. Remove the chicken and onion from the marinade and place them on the pan, spreading everything evenly across it. 1. Roast until the chicken is browned, crisp at the edges, and cooked through, about 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from the oven and let rest for 2 minutes, then slice into pieces. 1. Scatter the parsley over the top and serve with tomatoes, cucumbers, pita, white sauce, hot sauce, olives, fried eggplant, feta, rice, or your favorite accompaniments. notes For extra crisp edges, sear the sliced chicken in a hot pan with a little olive oil until it curls and browns. The chicken is flavorful enough to serve as a wrap, bowl, or platter. based on Source not recorded

title: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA
content: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA info About 40 minutes prep, 45 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1 teaspoon table salt 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts 1 cup plain whole milk yogurt 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 medium garlic cloves, minced or pressed (about 2 teaspoons) 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 medium onion, diced fine (about 1 1/4 cups) 2 medium garlic cloves, minced or pressed (about 2 teaspoons) 2 teaspoons grated fresh ginger 1 serrano chile, ribs and seeds removed, flesh minced 1 tablespoon tomato paste 1 tablespoon garam masala 1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes 2 teaspoons sugar table salt 2/3 cup heavy cream 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves steps 1. Combine cumin, coriander, cayenne, and salt in a small bowl. 1. Sprinkle both sides of the chicken with the spice mixture, pressing gently so the mixture adheres. 1. Place chicken on a plate, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 60 minutes. 1. In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, oil, garlic, and ginger; set aside. 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven or large pan over medium heat until shimmering. 1. Add onion and cook, stirring frequently, until light golden, 8 10 minutes. 1. Add garlic, ginger, chile, tomato paste, and garam masala; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 3 minutes. 1. Add crushed tomatoes, sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon salt; bring to a boil. 1. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. 1. Stir in cream and return to a simmer. 1. Remove the pan from heat and cover to keep warm. 1. While the sauce simmers, adjust the oven rack to the upper middle position (about 6 inches from the heating element) and heat the broiler. 1. Using tongs, dip the chicken into the yogurt mixture so it is coated with a thick layer of yogurt, then arrange the pieces on a wire rack set in a foil lined rimmed baking sheet or broiler pan. 1. Discard excess yogurt mixture. 1. Broil the chicken until the thickest parts register 160°F on an instant read thermometer and the exterior is lightly charred in spots, 10 18 minutes, flipping halfway through cooking. 1. Let the chicken rest 5 minutes, then cut it into 1 inch chunks and stir into the warm sauce (do not simmer the chicken in the sauce). 1. Stir in cilantro, adjust seasoning with salt, and serve. notes Use whole milk yogurt and heavy cream for a rich, silky sauce. Broiling the chicken gives it a slightly charred exterior without drying it out. based on Original recipe adapted from chicken tikka masala cooking techniques.

title: FRENCH CHICKEN STEW
content: FRENCH CHICKEN STEW info About 20 minutes prep, 4 to 6 hours total about 6 servings ingredients 3 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, trimmed Salt and pepper 1/4 cup vegetable oil 2 onions, minced 6 garlic cloves, minced 1 tablespoon tomato paste 2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme or 1/2 teaspoon dried 1/3 cup all purpose flour 1/2 cup dry white wine 4 cups low sodium chicken broth, plus extra as needed 12 ounces red potatoes (2 3 medium), scrubbed and cut into 1/2 inch pieces 4 carrots, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick 2 bay leaves 1 cup frozen peas 1/4 cup minced fresh parsley steps 1. Dry chicken with paper towels and season with salt and pepper. 1. Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a 12 inch skillet over medium high heat until just smoking. 1. Brown half the chicken lightly on both sides, 5 to 8 minutes; transfer to a bowl. Repeat with another tablespoon of oil and the remaining chicken, then transfer to the bowl. 1. Heat the remaining tablespoon of oil over medium high heat until shimmering. Add onions, garlic, tomato paste, and thyme and cook until onions are softened and lightly browned, about 8 to 10 minutes. 1. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in wine, scraping up any browned bits. 1. Whisk in 1 cup of broth, smoothing out any lumps, then transfer the mixture to a slow cooker. 1. Microwave potatoes and carrots with the remaining tablespoon of oil in a covered bowl, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are nearly tender, about 5 minutes. Transfer to the slow cooker. 1. Stir in the remaining 3 cups broth, peas, and bay leaves into the slow cooker. Nestle the browned chicken and any accumulated juices into the stew. 1. Cover and cook until the chicken is tender, 4 to 6 hours on low. 1. Transfer chicken to a cutting board, let cool slightly, then shred into bite sized pieces. 1. Let the stew settle for 5 minutes, then remove any fat from the surface with a large spoon. Discard bay leaves. 1. Stir shredded chicken into the stew. Adjust consistency with additional hot broth as needed. Stir in parsley and season with salt and pepper. notes Browning the chicken before slow cooking builds richer flavor. If the stew becomes too thick, add hot broth until it reaches the desired consistency. based on Homey Chicken Stew recipe adapted from Americas Test Kitchen

title: HUMMUS FATTEH
content: HUMMUS FATTEH info About 30 minutes prep, 1 hour total about 4 servings ingredients 2 cups cooked chickpeas, divided 1/3 cup tahini 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice 2 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste 1/3 cup olive oil, divided 4 pita rounds, cut into wedges 8 ounces ground beef or lamb 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 cup pine nuts 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley 1/4 cup plain yogurt (optional) Paprika or Aleppo pepper for garnish steps 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F. Toss pita wedges with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and salt, then spread on a baking sheet and bake until crisp and golden, about 10 minutes. 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until softened. 1. Add ground beef or lamb, cumin, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt. Cook, breaking up the meat, until browned and cooked through. Set aside. 1. In a blender or food processor, combine 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, salt, and remaining olive oil. Blend until smooth, adding a little water if needed to reach a creamy consistency. 1. In a small skillet, toast pine nuts over medium heat until lightly browned. Remove and set aside. 1. Arrange toasted pita chips in a shallow serving dish. Spread the hummus on top of the pita, leaving some chips visible. 1. Scatter the remaining chickpeas and cooked meat over the hummus. 1. Drizzle with yogurt if using, sprinkle with toasted pine nuts, chopped parsley, and a dusting of paprika or Aleppo pepper. notes For extra richness, warm the hummus slightly before assembling. You can swap the ground meat for toasted pine nuts alone for a vegetarian version. based on https://www.seriouseats.com/hummus fatteh recipe 8641111

title: Paneer With Mint and Chiles
content: Paneer With Mint and Chiles A creamy, lightly spiced paneer curry with fresh herbs and a bright lemon finish. info About 30 minutes 4 servings ingredients 1 1/2 cups fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems 1 1/2 cups fresh mint leaves 1 cup water, divided, plus more as needed 2 tablespoons ghee or neutral oil, divided 1 pound paneer, cubed into 1/2 inch pieces 1 small Spanish or white onion, thinly sliced 1 tablespoon freshly grated garlic or garlic paste 4 Thai green chiles, chopped 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 3/4 teaspoon Kashmiri or other red chile powder 1 teaspoon fine sea salt 2 tablespoons cashew or other nut butter 1/2 cup water, plus more as needed 2 tablespoons Greek or coconut yogurt (optional) Juice of 1 lemon (2 to 3 tablespoons) Basmati rice or naan, for serving (optional) steps 1. Blend the cilantro, mint, and 1/2 cup of the water in a blender until smooth and loose, similar to a green chutney. 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of the ghee in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the paneer in a single layer and cook undisturbed for about 2 minutes, until the surface touching the pan turns golden. Remove and set aside. 1. Add the remaining tablespoon of ghee to the pan. Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in the green chiles, cumin seeds, chile powder, and salt. Add the cashew butter and the herb mixture and stir until evenly combined. Add 1/2 cup water to thin the sauce. 1. Add the seared paneer back to the pan and stir until coated. If you want a looser sauce, add up to another 1/2 cup water a little at a time. Stir in the yogurt, if using, and the lemon juice. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Serve with rice or naan. notes The sauce can be made ahead and reheated gently before adding the paneer. For a brighter finish, add extra lemon juice just before serving. based on Source not recorded

title: PULLED CHICKEN
content: PULLED CHICKEN info About 10 minutes prep, 1 hour total about 4 servings ingredients 2 to 3 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs 1 tbsp olive oil 1 cup low sodium chicken broth 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar 2 tbsp tomato paste 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tbsp honey 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp kosher salt, plus more to taste 1/4 tsp black pepper 1 bay leaf 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley (optional) steps 1. Preheat the oven to 325°F. 1. In a large ovenproof skillet or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. 1. Season the chicken on both sides with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder. 1. Add the chicken to the skillet and brown lightly for 2 to 3 minutes per side. 1. Stir together chicken broth, apple cider vinegar, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and honey. 1. Pour the sauce over the chicken and add the bay leaf. 1. Cover the skillet and transfer it to the oven. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 1. Remove the chicken from the pan and shred it with two forks. Discard the bay leaf. 1. Return the shredded chicken to the sauce and toss to coat. If needed, simmer briefly on the stovetop to thicken the sauce. 1. Stir in chopped parsley, then serve warm. notes Use boneless breasts for lean meat or thighs for richer flavor. Serve over rice, in sandwiches, or tacos. based on https://www.wskg.org/arts/2025 03 21/americas test kitchen indoor pulled chicken ep 1909

title: Curry-Spiced Whole Roasted Cauliflower
content: Curry Spiced Whole Roasted Cauliflower A whole roasted cauliflower with a warm curry butter, toasted nuts, and a bright yogurt tahini sauce. info About 1 hour 15 minutes 4 servings ingredients 3 ounces butter 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon chopped garlic 1 teaspoon curry powder 1 head cauliflower Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 1/2 cup almonds, chopped 1/2 cup golden raisins 1 lime, zested and juiced 1/2 cup Greek yogurt 2 tablespoons tahini 1/4 cup dill, minced 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1 clove garlic, minced Juice of 1 lemon 1 cup cilantro leaves 1 cup mint leaves 1 Fresno chile, sliced steps 1. Preheat the oven to 450°F. 1. Heat the butter and olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat until the butter melts. Add the chopped garlic and curry powder and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. 1. Make a small foil ring wide enough to hold up the base of the cauliflower a little. Place the foil ring in a large sauté pan and set the cauliflower on top. Season with salt and pepper. Pour all but 1/4 cup of the curry butter over the cauliflower. 1. Roast the cauliflower for 10 minutes, then baste with some of the curry butter from the bottom of the pan. Continue roasting and basting until the cauliflower is tender, about 45 minutes total. 1. Meanwhile, add the almonds and raisins to the remaining curry butter in the saucepan and cook over medium heat until the nuts are toasted and the raisins are plump, about 3 minutes. Stir in the lime juice. 1. Remove the cauliflower to a serving platter and drizzle with any remaining butter from the pan. Top with the nut, raisin, and curry butter mixture and sprinkle with the lime zest. 1. For the sauce, whisk together the Greek yogurt, olive oil, tahini, dill, cumin, minced garlic, and lemon juice in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper. 1. Drizzle the cauliflower with the yogurt tahini sauce and garnish with cilantro, mint, and sliced Fresno chile. notes A foil ring helps the cauliflower stand upright and roast more evenly. The sauce can be made ahead and chilled until serving. based on https://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/geoffrey zakarian/curry spiced whole roasted cauliflower 7966610

title: ROASTED SWEET POTATOES
content: ROASTED SWEET POTATOES info About 15 minutes prep, 45 minutes total about 6 servings ingredients 3 pounds sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes 3 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp black pepper 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp ground cumin 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley 1 tbsp honey or maple syrup (optional) steps 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F. 1. In a large bowl, toss the sweet potato cubes with olive oil, salt, pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, and cayenne if using. 1. Spread the sweet potatoes in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet. 1. Roast for 20 minutes, then stir and rotate the pan to promote even browning. 1. Continue roasting for another 15 to 20 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender and caramelized around the edges. 1. Remove from the oven and drizzle with honey or maple syrup, if desired. 1. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and toss gently before serving. notes Cut the sweet potatoes into even pieces so they roast uniformly. The optional cayenne and honey add a nice sweet spicy balance. based on https://www.seriouseats.com/the best roasted sweet potatoes thanksgiving sides the food lab recipe

title: Grilled Italian Sausage With Sweet-and-Sour Peppers and Onions
content: Grilled Italian Sausage With Sweet and Sour Peppers and Onions A smoky, sweet and sour grill dinner with juicy sausages and caramelized peppers. info About 1 hour 10 minutes 4 servings ingredients 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1 large onion, sliced into 1/4 inch strips 2 red bell peppers, stems and cores removed, sliced into 1/4 inch strips 2 green bell peppers, stems and cores removed, sliced into 1/4 inch strips 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar 3 tablespoons sugar Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 2 pounds sweet or hot Italian sausage Buns, for serving steps 1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat until shimmering. Add the onions and peppers and cook, stirring often, until softened and browned in spots, about 8 minutes. 1. Add the vinegar and sugar, then remove from the heat and stir until the sugar dissolves. Season to taste with salt and pepper. 1. Transfer the pepper mixture to a disposable aluminum pan or a double layer foil tray. Nestle the sausages into the pan. 1. Place the pan on the hot side of the grill and cook until simmering, about 4 minutes. Slide it to the cooler side of the grill, cover, and cook until the sausages register 140 to 145°F, about 20 minutes, turning once halfway through. 1. Remove the sausages from the peppers and place them directly on the grill grate over the hot side. Cook, turning occasionally, until well browned and crisp, about 3 minutes total. Return them to the peppers and serve with buns. notes The peppers and onions can be made ahead and reheated gently before finishing the sausages on the grill. For extra sweetness, use sweet Italian sausage; for more heat, use hot sausage. based on https://www.seriouseats.com/grilled italian sausage with sweet and sour peppers and onions recipe

title: SAUTÉED GREEN BEANS WITH GARLIC AND HERBS
content: SAUTÉED GREEN BEANS WITH GARLIC AND HERBS info About 10 minutes prep, 20 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 1 lb green beans, trimmed 2 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp unsalted butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 tsp kosher salt, plus more to taste 1/4 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley 1 tsp chopped fresh thyme 1 tsp chopped fresh chives steps 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add green beans and blanch for 3 to 4 minutes until bright green and slightly tender. 1. Drain the beans and immediately transfer them to a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking and preserve color. Drain well and pat dry. 1. In a large skillet over medium heat, warm the olive oil and butter until the butter is melted and begins to foam. 1. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds to 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to brown it. 1. Add the drained green beans to the skillet and toss to coat in the garlic butter. 1. Cook, stirring frequently, until the beans are heated through and lightly browned in spots, about 4 to 6 minutes. 1. Season with salt and pepper, then stir in lemon juice and the chopped herbs. 1. Remove the pan from heat and transfer the green beans to a serving dish. notes Blanching the beans first keeps them crisp and intensely green. Add toasted slivered almonds or grated Parmesan for extra texture. based on https://www.seriouseats.com/cooks illustrated sauteed green beans recipe

title: Sous-Vide Chicken Breast
content: Sous Vide Chicken Breast A simple, juicy chicken breast with a soy brined flavor and a quick pan sear finish. info About 8 hours 30 minutes 1 serving ingredients 1 chicken breast 2 quarts (2 L) water 1/2 cup (130 g) soy sauce 1/8 cup (30 g) brown sugar 30 g kosher salt 4 garlic cloves, crushed 4 sprigs thyme 2 bay leaves 1 lemon, quartered 1 sprig rosemary 1 bunch parsley 2 teaspoons (5 g) black peppercorn 1 tablespoon (15 g) vegetable oil 1 tablespoon (15 g) kosher salt 1 teaspoon (3 g) fresh cracked black pepper 1 teaspoon (4 g) garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon (2 g) onion powder 1 teaspoon (5 g) MSG steps 1. In a 4 quart pot or storage container, whisk together the water, soy sauce, brown sugar, salt, garlic, thyme, rosemary, parsley, and black peppercorn until the salt dissolves. 1. Add the chicken breast to the brine, cover, and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours. 1. After brining, remove the chicken from the brine and pat it dry with a paper towel. 1. Preheat the sous vide to 66°C. 1. In a small bowl, whisk together the vegetable oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and MSG until fully incorporated. 1. Put the chicken breast in a vacuum sealed bag with the seasoning mixture, seal, and cook in the sous vide for 60 minutes. 1. Remove the chicken from the bag and pat it dry again. 1. Preheat a cast iron pan over medium high heat, then add a little vegetable oil until it begins to smoke. 1. Season the chicken lightly with salt and pepper, then sear for 2 to 3 minutes per side until nicely browned. notes The brine makes the chicken especially savory, so keep the sear quick and high heat. If you do not have a vacuum sealer, a zip top bag with the air pressed out works well. based on https://www.joshuaweissman.com/recipes/simple sous vide chicken breast recipe

title: 3-INGREDIENT STOVETOP MAC AND CHEESE
content: 3 INGREDIENT STOVETOP MAC AND CHEESE info About 5 minutes prep, 15 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 8 ounces elbow macaroni 1 1/2 cups evaporated milk 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese steps 1. Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add the macaroni and cook until just shy of al dente, about 6 minutes. 1. Drain the pasta and return it to the pan. Pour in the evaporated milk and heat over medium low until the liquid is warm. 1. Add the shredded cheddar a handful at a time, stirring constantly until the cheese has melted and the sauce is smooth. 1. Continue cooking gently for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is coated and the sauce is thickened. 1. Remove from the heat and let rest briefly before serving. notes Use a good quality sharp cheddar for the best flavor. If the sauce is too thick, add a splash of milk or reserved pasta water. based on https://www.seriouseats.com/ingredient stovetop mac and cheese recipe

title: TURKEY BURGERS
content: TURKEY BURGERS info About 10 minutes prep, 15 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 1 ¼ pounds 93% lean ground turkey ½ cup whole milk ricotta cheese ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon ground black pepper 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce 2 teaspoons Dijon mustard 1 tablespoon vegetable or canola oil 4 hamburger buns and preferred toppings steps 1. Mix ricotta, salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and Dijon mustard gently in a bowl. Once fully combined, add turkey and recombine. 1. Shape the mix into four equal patties, pressing a slight dimple into the center of each. 1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. 1. Cook patties without moving them until a dark golden crust forms, about 3 to 4 minutes. 1. Flip the burgers, cook until done through, and transfer to buns with your favorite toppings. notes Adding whole milk ricotta to the meat keeps lean turkey moist and tender. based on https://www.americastestkitchen.com/recipes/890 quicker turkey burgers https://www.zestfulkitchen.com/juicy dijon thyme turkey burger recipe/

title: TURKEY GREEN BEAN GINGER STIR FRY
content: TURKEY GREEN BEAN GINGER STIR FRY info About 5 minutes prep, 20 minutes total about 4 servings ingredients 2 tbsp olive oil, divided 1 lb green beans, trimmed and chopped Salt and pepper, to taste 1 lb ground turkey 1/2 cup onion, chopped 3 cloves garlic, minced 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce 2 tbsp honey 2 tsp chili garlic sauce 1 tsp sesame oil 1 tsp fresh ginger, grated 1/4 tsp pepper 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes steps 1. In a large skillet, heat one tablespoon of olive oil over medium high heat. Once the pan is hot, add green beans and season with a little salt and pepper. 1. Sauté the green beans for about 6 minutes until they start to get a little char and are tender, but still crisp. Transfer the green beans to a bowl and set aside. 1. Drizzle the remaining tablespoon of olive oil in the hot skillet and add the chopped onion. Sauté the onion until fragrant and translucent, about 2 to 3 minutes. 1. Add the garlic and sauté for an additional 30 seconds, being careful not to burn. 1. Add the ground turkey and brown until crumbled and turkey is fully cooked. 1. While the ground turkey is cooking, whisk together the soy sauce, chili garlic sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger, pepper, and red pepper flakes. 1. Add the cooked green beans back into the pan and pour in the sauce, mixing well so everything is coated. 1. Let everything simmer for 2 to 3 more minutes, until the sauce has thickened. Serve over hot rice and enjoy. notes If the sauce thickens too much, add a splash of water or broth to loosen it. based on adapted from a simple turkey and green bean stir fry recipe

title: Turmeric Asparagus Chicken
content: Turmeric Asparagus Chicken A quick skillet chicken with turmeric, asparagus, and a glossy honey sauce. info About 25 minutes 4 servings ingredients 3 tablespoons honey 3/4 teaspoon black pepper, plus more to taste Kosher salt (such as Diamond Crystal) 2 tablespoons all purpose flour 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch pieces 1 tablespoon coconut or canola oil 12 ounces asparagus, trimmed and thinly sliced on an angle 1 teaspoon unseasoned rice vinegar or soy sauce 1 lime, cut into wedges (optional) steps 1. In a small bowl or measuring cup, stir together 1/4 cup water with the honey, pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon salt; set the honey mixture aside. 1. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, turmeric, and 1 teaspoon salt. Add the chicken and toss until coated. 1. In a medium 10 inch nonstick skillet, heat the oil over medium high. Add the chicken and cook until the turmeric is fragrant and the chicken is golden brown on both sides, 2 to 3 minutes per side. 1. Add the asparagus, season with salt, stir to combine, and cook until crisp tender, 1 to 2 minutes. 1. Add the honey mixture and cook, stirring, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, 2 to 3 minutes. 1. Remove from the heat and stir in the vinegar. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with lime squeezed over the top, if you like. notes This is best served right away while the sauce is glossy and the asparagus is still bright. If you want a stronger savory note, swap the vinegar for soy sauce. based on Source not recorded
